analysis_type: Exploratory post hoc development diagnosis, selected known failures. Register analysis method before new diagnostic execution; not blind causal preregistration.
authorization: User requested continuing the existing robot experiment after the fixed-budget data intervention comparison.

geometry_method.exact_allocation: Three-block inclusion-exclusion and Shapley with all interactions retained
geometry_method.local_linearization: Unique actual-endpoint signed-distance derivative with nonlinear remainder. Exact nonsmooth ties NOT_DEFINED; conservative 1e-12m proximity guard NEAR_SWITCH_NOT_ASSESSED; this guard changes no physical validity threshold.
geometry_method.scope: Diagnostic geometry combinations, not physically feasible states, model re-prediction or causal interventions

error_method.yaw: 2pi principal errors and separate raw delta cumulative sum; no pi error reduction
error_method.batch_note: Saved free and teacher batches differ. First identical-input numerical difference is recorded, not claimed pure state-input effect.

support_method.primary_distance: L2 of frozen-normalizer float32 model boundary 11 features, not absolute-state mixed-unit distance
support_method.secondary_distance: float64 encoding only for sensitivity, no alternative rank selection
support_method.population: Unique training transition identities, retain overlapping window memberships and separate L_one teacher-target vs SK rollout start exposure
support_method.provenance: Old/new, family/episode/transition/depth, contact regime from existing actual contact summaries
support_method.limits: Nearness and exposure are descriptive. No sufficient-data threshold, overfit claim or model error attributed by nearest distance alone.

arithmetic_tolerance.meaning: Roundoff check only; unchanged physical and task thresholds

checks: Frozen parent/source SHA before and after
Target identity/real-state teacher input and zero commands
Geometry independent four-segment distance and 8-combination closure
NN input contract/rank/provenance and distinct teacher/rollout exposure
No training, learned forward, engine calls or primary result changes
